description: This script scans through source files in a project to detect potential violations related to Firecrawl-specific fetch logic. It searches for suspicious patterns in relevant files, excluding specific allowed or test files, to identify code that may have Firecrawl dependencies or logic embedded.

methods.name: collectWebFetchProviderBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Asynchronously scans project files to identify code lines that match suspicious patterns related to Firecrawl fetch logic, excluding allowed files and test files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that runs the violation collection, handles output formatting (JSON or plain text), and returns an appropriate exit code.
